entities.title: UI
entities.summary: The pixel art and font, the canvas drawing, the controls and the sound.
entities.purpose: Turns the engine's Game and its events into what the player sees and hears on a 224×288 canvas, and keys and on-screen buttons into one Input a frame.
boundaries: Decides nothing about the game: the engine does. render() reads the Game and never changes it.
No image or sound files: every sprite and glyph is a pixel map in art.ts, and every sound is made with Web Audio.
